description: Anonymous, read-only eBay HTTP scope. Search suggestions have historical live receipts. Documents and SSR product data are eligible HTTP inputs, but listings, details, categories and pagination still need a verified parser and independent replay. The 2026-10-15 Electronics Document replay returned HTTP 403.

capabilities.title: Read public keyword suggestions and query-linked category hints without a login or developer token

evidence.note: Current anonymous autosug read returned 10 suggestions and 2 category hints. Listing, detail, and pagination remain unverified.

capabilities.note: The live response contains suggestions and optional category hints, not product search results or a complete category taxonomy.

capabilities.title: Search product listings through an observed anonymous HTTP response
capabilities.blocker: Historical browser HTML contained listings. The current direct GET /sch/i.html returned 403 text/html with an Error Page and no product cards; see verification/remaining-consumer-2026-10-16/diagnosis.json. Suggestions remain a separate working contract.

capabilities.title: Read a listing-bound item identity and complete detail object through anonymous HTTP
capabilities.blocker: Historical browser item 306337924086 opened a sold-out ePID hub without product-detail JSON. The current direct GET for the same item returned 403 text/html; see verification/remaining-consumer-2026-10-16/diagnosis.json. No successful maintained detail reader is established.

capabilities.title: Read current listing price and currency through anonymous HTTP
capabilities.blocker: The sampled listing redirected to a sold-out product hub; no listing-specific price and currency XHR was observed or replayed.

capabilities.title: Read full listing description through anonymous HTTP
capabilities.blocker: Product information was visible in the document; no listing description XHR or independently replayed fragment was verified.

capabilities.title: Read primary and secondary listing images through anonymous HTTP
capabilities.blocker: The observed secondary-image request needs pageci and listing IDs derived from the document; no standalone direct replay has been verified.

capabilities.title: Read listing options and variant-specific selection data through anonymous HTTP
capabilities.blocker: The sampled product hub showed variation controls, but no variant-selection XHR schema or direct replay was verified.

capabilities.title: Map listing ID to the correct review-bearing product identity
capabilities.blocker: One product page linked listing iid to ePID 25056255340, but no reusable XHR contract maps arbitrary listing IDs to review-bearing ePIDs. Seller feedback is a separate scope.

capabilities.title: Read product review count and rating distribution
capabilities.blocker: A sampled ePID page showed 558 ratings in its document; no rating-summary XHR or independent JSON replay was observed.

capabilities.title: Read full public product review text and metadata
capabilities.blocker: Historical review cards appeared in a 200 HTML Document. A reusable Document parser, product/review identity binding and independent readback remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Read photos attached to public product reviews
capabilities.blocker: No review photos appeared on the sampled ePID, so photo fields and media URLs remain unverified; no review-data XHR was observed.

capabilities.title: Traverse all public review pages with a bounded stopping condition
capabilities.blocker: Historical HTML linked pgn=1–7. Reusable HTTP traversal, deduplication and terminal-condition verification remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Read browse categories through anonymous HTTP
capabilities.blocker: No anonymous category XHR response schema and direct replay established.

capabilities.title: Traverse search results with bounded HTTP pagination
capabilities.blocker: A Document pagination route is an eligible HTTP contract, but its inputs, parser and stopping condition have not been independently verified.

capabilities.title: Read secondary listing images from the observed auxiliary XHR
capabilities.note: The browser request includes a pageci value and listing IDs from the HTML page. A standalone anonymous input source and replay are unverified.

capabilities.title: Sign in to a buyer or seller account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user explicitly scoped the marketplace integration to public reads without login.

capabilities.title: Cart, bid, order, address or seller mutation
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested only public anonymous reads; account and transaction writes are outside the authorized scope.
